external_scopes.scope: All waited children in the corresponding observation interval. Per-native intervals can be separated from build/reader/source-guard intervals; an outer aggregate includes whichever phases it encloses. ru_maxrss is cumulative peak, not an additive RSS total or isolated command quota.
Coordinator process and its observer thread, including orchestration/evidence processing. Not child Rust CPU, not whole-host CPU and not energy.

independent_recalculation_rules: Preserve exact raw names and source-derived clock scope in all derived tables.
Use like-for-like numerator/denominator: native thread CPU with native thread CPU, or wall elapsed with wall elapsed; never cross-divide them.
Do not call four-kernel Instant durations CPU cost or energy.
Do not relabel true ThreadCPUTime fields as wall elapsed solely because the same helper also stores Instant.
Inclusive cohort/run/process envelopes overlap setup/search/verification phases; add only disjoint phases and never double-add setup to a total that already includes it.
Observer CPU, build and Python reader costs have separate process/interval provenance. They may affect wall samples without becoming native ThreadCPUTime.
None of these clocks measures joules, power or total machine CPU consumption.

native_scopes.cpu_source: Shared w1_cost_producers::Clock. Linux clock_gettime_dynamic(DynamicClockId::Known(ClockId::ThreadCPUTime)); before/after delta accepted only on the same std::thread::ThreadId. Missing/invalid CPU clocks produce None, not Instant fallback.
Same shared w1_cost_producers::Clock and actual Linux ThreadCPUTime delta.
native_scopes.wall_source: Separate wall_ns fields use Instant elapsed.

native_scopes.cpu_source: Same shared w1_cost_producers::Clock and actual Linux ThreadCPUTime delta.

native_scopes.cpu_source: Local cpu_ns() uses Linux rustix ThreadCPUTime. Clock::observe computes same-thread before/after CPU delta; non-Linux or invalid clock gives None.
native_scopes.wall_source: Local Clock::observe separately uses Instant elapsed for wall_ns.

native_scopes.interpretation: Keep original raw field names, but label sums and ratios as wall-elapsed measurement, never ThreadCPUTime/process CPU or energy.
native_scopes.wall_source: All these measured native durations are std::time::Instant elapsed intervals, including verifier elapsed_ns and generic *_ns fields.

older_entrypoints: Legacy crypto examples with similar names are not substituted for the three current node example entrypoints. No older command was executed or given current-sample credit.
